metadata.article_title: Act of Judge when acting judicially

article.title: Act of Judge when acting judicially
article.content: Nothing is an offence which is done by a Judge when acting judicially in the exercise of any power which is, or which in good faith he believes to be, given to him by law.
article.html:
15Act of Judge when acting judicially

Section 15 · Chapter III

Nothing is an offence which is done by a Judge when acting judicially in the exercise of any power which is, or which in good faith he believes to be, given to him by law.
